approval_policy.description: Approval policy for the ACME Bonsai CTO team (Allen)

approve_feature_small.notes: Features ≤ 40 hours and ≤ $3K: Allen approves. Spec required.

approve_feature_large.notes: Features > 40 hours OR > $3K cost: Jane approval required.

approve_release.notes: Standard releases: Allen approves after staging QA. No Friday deploys; no pre-campaign deploys.

approve_major_release.notes: Major releases (architecture changes, platform migrations, schema migrations affecting prod data): Jane approval required.

approve_rollback.notes: Production rollback during incident requires Jane sign-off (or Allen acting on Jane's prior delegation during off-hours).

approve_saas_addition.notes: Any new SaaS / vendor subscription > $200/month requires Jane approval. CFO (Sterling) informed for budget tracking.

approve_security_risk_acceptance.notes: Deferring a high/critical security finding requires documented risk acceptance from both Allen + Jane.

approve_data_destruction.notes: Any deletion of production data, table drop, or destructive migration requires Jane approval.

emergency_stop.notes: Emergency stop on deploys can be activated immediately by Allen or Jane.
